# Device profiles on this card, for the andr36oid SD flasher. One line per profile:
#   folder|console|name|flags
# console groups the list in the flasher, name is what it shows. flags, comma separated:
#   experimental        the flasher asks before using it
#   also=<console>;...  listed under those consoles too
#   hidden              not offered: a copy at a board's old path, kept for older
#                       flashers (0.3.3 and before show it) and for cards set up before
#                       the move (mkimg.sh makes the copy)
# mkimg.sh checks that every profile folder has a line here.
